{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module Auth.RBAC where

import System.Process (readProcess)
import System.IO (withBinaryFile, IOMode(ReadMode), hSetBinaryMode)
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import Data.Char (isAlphaNum, isSpace)
import Data.List (isPrefixOf, intercalate)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Control.Monad (when, unless)
import Data.IORef
import Text.Printf (printf)

data Role = Admin | Auditor | User deriving (Show, Eq, Ord)

data Session = Session
  { sessionUser :: String
  , sessionRole :: Role
  , sessionToken :: String
  } deriving (Show)

type SessionStore = IORef (Map.Map String Session)

data AuditBackend = FileBackend FilePath | SyslogBackend String

-- | Sanitize identifiers: allow alphanumeric, underscore, hyphen, dot
sanitizeIdent :: String -> String
sanitizeIdent = filter (\c -> isAlphaNum c || c == '_' || c == '-' || c == '.')

-- | Validate that a username contains no shell metacharacters
validateUsername :: String -> Bool
validateUsername [] = False
validateUsername name = all (\c -> isAlphaNum c || c == '_' || c == '-' || c == '.') name
                        && length name <= 64
                        && length name >= 1

-- | Encode a field for structured logging
encodeField :: String -> String
encodeField = concatMap escape
  where
    escape '"' = "\\\"" 
    escape '\\' = "\\\\"
    escape c = [c]

-- | Format an audit message with structured fields
formatAuditMessage :: String -> String -> String -> String
formatAuditMessage action user detail =
  "[AUTH] action=" ++ encodeField action ++
  " user=" ++ encodeField user ++
  " detail=" ++ encodeField detail

-- | Write audit log entry via the configured backend
writeAuditLog :: AuditBackend -> String -> String -> String -> IO ()
writeAuditLog (FileBackend path) action user detail = do
  let msg = formatAuditMessage action user detail
  appendFile path (msg ++ "\n")
writeAuditLog (SyslogBackend facility) action user detail = do
  let msg = formatAuditMessage action user detail
  -- Use logger command for syslog integration
  _ <- readProcess "logger" ["-p", facility, msg] ""
  return ()

-- | Authenticate user against PAM-style backend
authenticateUser :: String -> String -> IO (Maybe Role)
authenticateUser username password = do
  unless (validateUsername username) $ error "Invalid username format"
  -- In production this would call PAM; simplified for demonstration
  result <- readProcess "id" ["-gn", sanitizeIdent username] ""
  let group = filter (not . isSpace) result
  return $ case group of
    "wheel"   -> Just Admin
    "audit"   -> Just Auditor
    "users"   -> Just User
    _         -> Nothing

-- | Create a new session after successful authentication
createSession :: SessionStore -> String -> Role -> IO Session
createSession store username role = do
  token <- generateToken username
  let sess = Session username role token
  modifyIORef' store (Map.insert token sess)
  return sess

-- | Generate a cryptographically secure session token.
-- Reads raw random bytes directly from /dev/urandom in binary mode
-- (avoiding text-decoding corruption) and hex-encodes them.
generateToken :: String -> IO String
generateToken _username = do
  bytes <- withBinaryFile "/dev/urandom" ReadMode $ \h -> do
    hSetBinaryMode h True
    BS.hGet h 32
  return $ concatMap (printf "%02x") (BS.unpack bytes)

-- | Role-based authorization check
authorize :: Session -> Role -> Bool
authorize sess requiredRole = sessionRole sess >= requiredRole

-- | Admin action: look up user details via system command
-- Only accessible to Admin role
adminLookupUser :: Session -> AuditBackend -> String -> IO (Either String String)
adminLookupUser sess backend targetUser = do
  if not (authorize sess Admin)
    then return $ Left "Insufficient privileges"
    else do
      writeAuditLog backend "admin_lookup" (sessionUser sess) targetUser
      if validateUsername targetUser
        then do
          result <- readProcess "getent" ["passwd", sanitizeIdent targetUser] ""
          return $ Right result
        else return $ Left "Invalid target username"

-- | Auditor action: search audit logs
-- The search term is passed to grep for filtering
auditorSearchLogs :: Session -> AuditBackend -> String -> IO (Either String String)
auditorSearchLogs sess backend searchTerm = do
  if not (authorize sess Auditor)
    then return $ Left "Insufficient privileges"
    else do
      writeAuditLog backend "audit_search" (sessionUser sess) searchTerm
      case backend of
        FileBackend path -> do
          let safePath = sanitizeIdent path
          result <- readProcess "grep" ["-F", searchTerm, safePath] ""
          return $ Right result
        SyslogBackend _ -> return $ Left "Search not supported for syslog backend"

-- | Allowed notification commands (whitelist)
allowedNotifyCommands :: [String]
allowedNotifyCommands = ["/usr/local/bin/notify", "/usr/bin/notify-send"]

-- | User action: change display name
-- Triggers a notification via the configured notification command
userChangeDisplayName :: Session -> AuditBackend -> String -> String -> IO (Either String ())
userChangeDisplayName sess backend notifyCmd newName = do
  writeAuditLog backend "change_name" (sessionUser sess) newName
  if not (all (\c -> isAlphaNum c || isSpace c) newName)
    then return $ Left "Invalid display name characters"
    else if notifyCmd `notElem` allowedNotifyCommands
      then return $ Left "Unauthorized notification command"
      else do
        -- Notify via configured command, passing username and new name as arguments
        let args = buildNotifyArgs (sessionUser sess) newName
        _ <- readProcess notifyCmd args ""
        return $ Right ()

-- | Build argument list for notification command
-- The session username was validated at login; newName validated above
buildNotifyArgs :: String -> String -> [String]
buildNotifyArgs username newName =
  ["--user", username, "--name", newName]

-- | Login endpoint combining authentication and session creation
login :: SessionStore -> AuditBackend -> String -> String -> IO (Either String Session)
login store backend username password = do
  if not (validateUsername username)
    then return $ Left "Invalid username"
    else do
      authResult <- authenticateUser username password
      case authResult of
        Nothing -> do
          writeAuditLog backend "login_failed" username "bad_credentials"
          return $ Left "Authentication failed"
        Just role -> do
          sess <- createSession store username role
          writeAuditLog backend "login_success" username (show role)
          return $ Right sess
